title: CareerOS Achievement
description: A schema for representing a professional achievement within CareerOS.

id.description: A stable identifier for the achievement.

description.description: A detailed description of the achievement.

organization.description: The organization associated with the achievement.

impact.description: A description of the achievement's impact.

metrics.description: Quantitative measures associated with the achievement.

date.description: The date associated with the achievement.

metadata.description: Lifecycle and governance metadata for the achievement record.
